description: Frontalier health cover: LAMal (CH) vs CMU/PUMa (FR). · Couverture santé frontalier : LAMal (CH) ou CMU (FR). — Estimates the monthly cost of the two health-insurance options a France–Switzerland cross-border worker chooses between (droit d'option): Swiss LAMal (in CHF) vs French CMU/PUMa (in EUR, a % of income). Dependants are priced by age band (0-18 child, 19-25 young adult, 26+ adult). Deterministic official premium/rate tables — no AI. Returns both monthly figures + the data year, plus how to transmit the signed choice form (the CPAM's dedicated online téléservice).
